I hired Samwise Gamgee as a gardener and then changed his role to "gardener, mayor". I also dismissed Bilbo Baggins. I checked both records afterwards. Samwise (employee 3) shows as working with the new role, and Bilbo's status is dismissed.

The first hire attempt was logged as "refused", then as "new resource". Samwise exists once, as employee 3, and I didn't look into why it was logged that way.

I saved the steps as a script called `hire-update-dismiss`.

Frodo Baggins's role is now "ring bearer, retired". It was "ring bearer" before, and the service's record shows the new value saved. ARTIE also kept the steps as a script named `retire-frodo-baggins`.
